import Part, Sketcher, FreeCAD as App
V = App.Vector
body = doc.addObject('PartDesign::Body', 'Body')
sk = body.newObject('Sketcher::SketchObject', 'Profile')
sk.AttachmentSupport = [(body.Origin.OriginFeatures[3], '')]
sk.MapMode = 'FlatFace'
for i, (a, b) in enumerate([((0,0),(8,0)), ((8,0),(8,16)), ((8,16),(0,16)), ((0,16),(0,0))]):
    sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(V(a[0], a[1], 0), V(b[0], b[1], 0)))
for i in range(4):
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', i, 2, (i + 1) % 4, 1))
for i in (0, 2):
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Horizontal', i))
for i in (1, 3):
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Vertical', i))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceX', -1, 1, 0, 1, 0))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceY', -1, 1, 0, 1, 0))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceX', 0, 1, 0, 2, 8))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceY', 1, 1, 1, 2, 16))
doc.recompute()
pad = body.newObject('PartDesign::Pad', 'Block')
pad.Profile = sk
pad.Length = 5
doc.recompute()
result = ('built', sk.FullyConstrained)
